outputlag.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies — nothing else unlocks it. Budget around 200 hours: the long tail is the 100% completion checklist, not the story. Work the roadmap in order (story, checklist, cleanup) and this pops last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it is a few minutes late.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay, so a chapter save is your only way back.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago the moment it appears (hourglass icon) — that race strand feeds the Strangers & Freaks count.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Bank vaults open near the end of this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — do it before the finale, while you still have the chapter's missions around you.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, and the post-story free roam is where most of the cleanup happens.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion only after the story, but work done during the story already counts. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied and 70 of 80 challenges. The only parts that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy in the game.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past 250 — the extra 50 are already on the checklist.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — fishing, racing, arcade games, the shooting range, bowling, the gym and the rest. You only need to try each one, not win it, so dip into anything new the moment you see it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 gold medals across two shooting ranges. The golds are not too difficult, per PowerPyx; work through both ranges' challenges until every one is gold. The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations. Win at least one race at each; the 100% checklist needs all of them too, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, and 100% completion needs 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish with Cal and win the challenge — do it in Chapter 1 while fishing is fresh, and keep a save handy in case the challenge goes wrong.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade game through to its end — finishing one game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only and stays available after the credits, so there is no rush — finish it in free roam.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline stays available after the credits, so finish it in free roam.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's questline stays available after the credits, so finish it in free roam.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish, and do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 the moment it appears (hourglass icon).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's questline stays available after the credits, so finish it in free roam.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and stays available after the credits, so finish it in free roam.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. THIS IS THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (the morning after Down to Earth — follow her to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task) disappears once Chapter 1 ends. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close; meditating with your partner at each outdoor spot should count twice, so bring them along. Keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting questline is Jason-only and works through target decks; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. The questline stays available after the credits.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets holding 480 cards in total, each set 18–36 cards. The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting well past 3 — track them under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan locations with the WAiNK app as you travel; the 100% checklist needs 100 WAiNK locations scanned, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges; 100% needs 70 of the 80, so you can skip the hardest ones, and many complete on their own while you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bank vault jobs give you 4 stars straight away — escape one with your partner and this pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade to the red heat zone only, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive; 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is slow-motion aim (L3 + R3 while aiming); pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked on the open airfield do not count. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km from the airport before it pops. Save first: the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — that is what 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' means. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies: use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run the roads of Leonida — hit one, grab the cash and lose the wanted level; like the vault jobs, it pops once you are clear of the red heat zone, not just the search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Drive, fly and walk the whole map until every named area has been visited; the 100% checklist counts discovery on its own, so exploring early pays off twice.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations cleared, so this pops along the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint, and it may pop while you play normally. Try a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail with the view in front of you.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint. Try driving a car out through a showroom's glass front and see if it pops.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation visited in Chapter 2: bring Sticky Bombs, take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe's contents (blow it open with a Sticky Bomb) — then escape the police. Leaving something behind is fine: the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength: buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. Pushing toward the Irredeemable profile is permanent, so read up on the Criminal Profile before you chase it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint; it most likely pops on a second attempt at something after a first failure.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint; it most likely pops when you witness something strange out in Leonida.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint; try knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts; the $250,000 total is cumulative.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so ordinary spending on the way to the platinum counts toward it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000; garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
